outcomeBoundary: No native scenario is claimed as passed and no PBIX was produced.

blocker.message: The controlled-run PBIP snapshot was materialized below the worktree. A Desktop-created SemanticModel .pbi editor settings path exceeded the legacy 248-character directory and 260-character filename limits, so Desktop crashed before an owned report window appeared.

remediation: Move only the immutable launch snapshot to a deterministic content-addressed short LOCALAPPDATA root, preflight all fixture and Desktop-created paths, and retain the release PBIX at its deterministic repository path.
